text:
maria_pm: Quick sync — we need to lock the rollout gating and handoff for the Customer Beta (priority tenants). TL;DR: phased regional roll, per-tenant opt-in, and clear fallback ownership.
kevin_sre: +1. Can we list hard launch criteria first? latency, errors, and quality regression are the big ones.
anya_eng: Proposed launch gates: p95 latency < 250ms, 5xx < 0.1% for 1h, and no quality regression on our priority prompt set (A/B test).
sam_ds: For quality: run the eval suite against a 100-sample prompt set flagged by the customer. Acceptable delta: BLEU/ROUGE-style metric delta <= 2 points or human review pass-rate >= 95%.
lisa_support: Customer wants an opt-in flag per-tenant. They also need an early rollback path they can trigger.
maria_pm: Ok — rollout plan sketch: stage 0 = internal canary (team only), stage 1 = 3 tenant canary (low traffic), stage 2 = 25% of priority tenants, stage 3 = 100% priority tenants, stage 4 = full prod. Regions: US-EAST -> EU -> APAC.
kevin_sre: Add autoscale smoke check during each stage (throughput + latency). If scaling fails or p95 spikes by >30% hold and rollback.
anya_eng: Feature flag naming and gradation example:
```
flag: feature.customer.beta.priority_tenants
values: off / canary-3 / canary-25 / rollout-100
```
Also include an emergency "kill-switch": feature.customer.beta.priority_tenants = off.
sam_ds: A/B test plan: 50/50 split during stage 2 for 24h on quality metrics. If quality delta > threshold, auto-hold. We'll need telemetry hooks to surface token-level diffs.
ops-bot: deploy-bot scheduled canary window: 2025-03-12T15:00Z to 2025-03-12T18:00Z.
deploy-bot: canary started for tenant alpha-03 (3% traffic).
lisa_support: Support playbook items: email template, rollback script, customer-facing FAQ. I can draft the FAQ.
maria_pm: Ownership: Eng (anya) owns flag rollout config and tests. SRE (kevin) owns auto-scaling and circuit breakers. DS (sam) owns eval thresholds and A/B analysis. Support (lisa) owns comms. PM (maria) owns go/no-go.
kevin_sre: Fallback policies to document: 1) soft-fallback to quantized model variant when latency > threshold for >2m; 2) hard-fallback to prior stable model on >0.2% 5xx in 5m; 3) per-tenant disabled flag if customer requests.
anya_eng: Implementation notes: add prefix cache warmup before canary, and a warm traffic window at each ramp step. Also tag traces with `rollout_stage` and `tenant_id` for slicing in dashboards.
sam_ds: Metrics to wire: p50/p95/p99 latency, token cost delta per request, 5xx rate, model-quality score, human-flagged regressions. Dashboards: one per-region + a combined global view.
maria_pm: Launch checklist items: final doc + runbook, flag naming + IaC change, monitoring dashboard + alerts, confirm SLOs, customer opt-in signed, support comms ready.
lisa_support: I'll own the comms draft and the customer opt-in flow. ETA EOD tomorrow. :thumbsup:
kevin_sre: Can we set an automated canary rollback if any of these happen within the 1h window: 5xx > 0.2%, p95 > 400ms, or quality-drop > threshold? If yes, add to runbook.
anya_eng: Yes — we have the automation hooks. I'll add the three rules and a manual confirmation gate for developer override.
maria_pm: Risk notes: APAC region likely needs a longer bake due to network variance. Plan extra 24h in APAC stage.
sam_ds: Also capture customer prompts for offline repros in case of quality complaints.
maria_pm: Next steps: Anya to update rollout YAML, Kevin to verify auto-rollback rules, Sam to finalize eval thresholds, Lisa to draft comms. We reconvene tomorrow 10:30 PT.
kevin_sre: :eyes: I'll add the alert runbook snippets and schedule DR drill with infra team.
deploy-bot: canary completed for tenant alpha-03 — metrics normal.
ops-bot: note: stage 1 -> scheduled ramp to canary-25 at 2025-03-12T16:00Z unless held.
maria_pm: Thanks everyone — I'll push the final go/no-go checklist to the doc and ping the channel when ready.
